in_sanskrit.name: Kiyara
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain Flower
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Kiyara एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Kiyara is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kiyar', which means 'Mountain Flower'. This name is associated with the beauty and grace of nature, and symbolizes joy and happiness.
